evidence.title: Lithium-ion batteries are reshaping data centers, fire safety must keep pace

summary: Data centers are increasingly adopting lithium‑ion battery systems to boost energy efficiency and support renewable power integration. The shift brings heightened fire‑risk challenges, prompting operators and regulators to tighten safety standards and upgrade protection measures.
title: Lithium‑Ion Batteries Transform Data Centers, Raising Fire‑Safety Concerns
